approved_relationships_preserved_in_cano: 联合城和人民天国同超级大陆
北冠半岛、抵抗者之弧三处山口
白石城、新来戈、溪热湖盆的已确认相对关系
25个已录用海域名称不附会位置
canon_scope: Only preexisting relative geographic relations are canon. All global continent polygons and hypothetical latitude coverage remain optional.

methods: Discard old straight-cut fragment corridors AND old nearby tile-like candidate islands
Independent smoothly sampled anisotropic radial forms with 2/3/4/6/9/14/22/34 harmonic scales
Variable bays recessed by circular Gaussian envelopes
Three to seven asymmetric spatial clusters distributing satellites, rejecting collisions
Large mainlands and satellites have different contour frequencies and sizes
limits: Current grouped island counts are drawing indexes, not official geography
No real crustal process or measured coastline claimed
Stated historical Shattered Sea 32 island chains remain canon but were never identified with the displaced anonymized island polygons
B12 proximity lines and B13 highland seeds no longer geometry valid

limitations: 候选地图世界图纸不代表确定实际经纬度、行星半径或真实各大陆面积
B14不继承B12旧岸线59条近邻配对，也不继承B13旧岸线8处高地种子
正式25个主要海洋名称与碎洋32条岛链设定不以这里匿名绘图多边形代替
岸线几何为有机形态构图试验，不是实测或真实地质/沉积模型
